architecture.statement: KEEP_LATEST unifies Developer and Support Feature policy documents under one machine contract family while retaining each plane and Family normative responsibility.

contracts.statement: Each policy rule declares its RA, RAC and AEC applicability and direct references. Evaluation eligibility requires the exact registered owner, contract ID and revision; execution authorization is checked separately.

governance.statement: KEEP_LATEST authorizes immediate staged structural migration of all policy documents in both planes and all fourteen Families. Preserve policy identity, original lifecycle and meaning; retain unresolved decisions explicitly and verify each document before and after conversion.

schema_source_management.statement: Manage canonical PTSIP schema sources centrally under src/ptsip/schemas/ using config.json as the schema location and contract registry. Existing distributed schemas are reference inputs for contract review; their relocation, replacement, or retirement is not automatically authorized.
